name: web-scraper
description: A high-performance web extraction suite. Uses Trafilatura logic for fast article reading and Puppeteer for heavy JS rendering.

read_article.description: EXTREMELY FAST. Best for reading blogs, news, documentation, or any static article. Automatically strips ads/junk and squashes tokens for local 7B models.

url.description: The exact URL of the article to read.

read_webpage.description: HEAVY RENDERER. Use ONLY if 'read_article' fails or for complex SPAs like Twitter, React apps, or interactive dashboards.

crawl_site.description: SPIDER. Discover multiple related pages from a single URL via sitemaps or RSS feeds. Returns a summary list of links.

url.description: The base URL or sitemap link.

maxPages.description: Max number of pages to discover (default 5).

discover_api.description: Performs deep network exploration of a website to identify internal API endpoints and JSON signatures. Useful for 'Teachable Agent' workflows.
